{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the QA orders
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Confirm they are indeed 6
assert len(qa_orders) == 6, "Expected exactly 6 QA orders"

# Also confirm that the revenue column is string
print(f"Revenue dtype: {sales['revenue'].dtype}")

# Check if there are any non-numeric revenue strings
revenue_sample = sales['revenue'].sample(10)
print(f"Sample of revenue strings: {revenue_sample.tolist()}")"}
